|quest_reward3_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} {{for|the monster version of the Chaos Golem|Chaos Sentinel|Chaos Golem (monster)}} '''Summon Chaos Golem''' is a [[minion]] [[spell]], summoning a [[Golem]] that grants the player [[chaos resistance]] and [[damage over time]] multiplier while active. The Chaos Golem can use a damage over time chaos aura and a cascade of chaos spikes in addition to its melee attack. ==Abilities== * '''Pummel:'''https://www.pathofexile.com/theawakening/skills Regular melee attack, 100% physical damage * '''Cascade of Chaos spikes:''' AoE spell similar to {{Item link|Glacial Cascade}} with 100% of physical damage converted to chaos damage on a 3 second cooldown, does two hits most of the time. AoE radius increases range and width. Can be supported by {{Item link|Spell Echo Support}}. * '''{{stl|Chaos Sandstorm}}:''' Chaos damage over time aura approximately 20 units in radius that lasts for 5 seconds after being cast with an 8 second cooldown. Affected by modifiers to golem's spell damage. If multiple chaos golems are summoned only the aura that deals the most damage will affect the enemy. Multiple auras do not stack. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = DoT
Multi | c1_header = Golems grant +x% to Damage over Time Multiplier | c1_pattern_extract = Golems grant %+(%d+)%% to Damage over Time Multiplier | c1_pattern_value = +%d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list |query= mods.generation_type=10 AND mod_spawn_weights.tag = "helmet" AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0 AND mods.id LIKE "%ChaosGolem%" }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Chaos Golem%" OR items.description LIKE "%chaos%golem%" ) }} {{clear}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Summon Chaos Golem: Golems now grant +17% to Chaos Damage Resistance at all gem levels, replacing the 3-5% additional Physical Damage Reduction Golems previously granted at gem levels 1-20. Golems also now grant +10-16% to Damage over Time Multiplier at gem levels 1-20. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * No longer has 0-38% increased Minion Maximum Life. Summoned Chaos Golems now have 20% more Life inherently. * Quality now provides 0-20% increased Buff Effect, instead of causing Minions to deal 0-20% increased Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * The damage and life scaling values for minions have been adjusted. Generally speaking, minion life and damage is unchanged in the very early game, roughly 30% lower in mid acts, roughly 20% lower at level 20 of the minion skill, and roughly 10% lower at level 30 of the minion skill. * Gem quality no longer grants 0–20% increased Minion Maximum Life. * The default quality {{c|mod|Minions deal 1% increased Damage}} is retained. {{Undocumented}} * Now has 20% more base life at all levels. * Now has 0% increased Minion Maximum Life at gem level 1 (previously 30%), up to 38% at gem level 20 (previously 68%). * The golem's Cascade spell now has an Added Damage Effectiveness of 100% (previously 60%), has a cooldown of 3 seconds (previously 3.5 seconds), has a base Critical Strike chance of 5% (previously 0%), and has approximately 10% higher base Area of Effect. The golem's chaos storm skill now deals up to 25% more damage at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Carrion, Chaos, Flame, Ice and Lightning Golems now regenerate 1% of their Life per second. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Chaos Golem now has an aggro range of 50. }} {{Version history table row|3.8.0| * Cascade skill now converts 100% of Physical Damage to Chaos, and has a larger area of effect. * Sandstorm skill now deals more damage at higher levels, and benefits from modifiers to the golem's spell damage. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Summon Chaos Golem has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}} [[Category:Buffs]]
